units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:8">Ab. Zar. III, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 48b:11">48ᵇ</cite>) <he>מפני שהנ׳ נושרת עליהן וכ׳</he> Y. a. Bab. ed. (Mish. <he>הנְמָיָיה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6) because the foliage of the Asherah drops on them &c., v. <cite ref="G00047"><he>זֶבֶל</he></cite>. Ib. 48ᵇ <he>מה שמשׁביח בנ׳ וכ׳</he> the benefit conferred upon a plant by its foliage, is neutralized by the disadvantage of the shade.

<cite ref="Mishnah Meilah 3:8">Meïl. III, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Meilah 14a:22">14ᵃ</cite>) <he>לא בשיפויי ולא בנ׳</he> Rashi (Bab. ed. <cite ref="N00085"><he>נְבָיָיא</he></cite>; Mish. <cite ref="N00356"><he>נְוָיָה</he></cite>) neither by using the shavings nor by using the sproutings (twigs &c. of the dedicated tree); <cite ref="Temurah 31b:54">Tem. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>שפויי ונ׳</he> Rashi (ed. <cite ref="N00605"><he>נִיבָא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Tosefta Meilah 1:25">Tosef. Meïl. I, 25</cite> <cite ref="N00870"><he>נְמָיָא</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <cite ref="N00857"><he>נְמוֹיָיה</he></cite>; <cite ref="M01215"><he>מנוייה</he></cite>, corr. acc.)
